PLAN "12-Week Bodyweight Strength Foundation"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build foundational strength with minimal equipment"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Movement Mastery" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Upper Push & Core":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 2m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x5..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          pike_push_up 3x5..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x20..30 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 90s
          shoulder_stretch 90s
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Lower Body & Pull":
        warmup:
          leg_swings 2m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x6..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 3x3..6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 90s
          hip_flexor_stretch 90s
      DAY Friday training 40m "Full Body Endurance":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 2m
